name: Participant Recruitment Strategies
consequences: Enhancing recruitment strategies can significantly increase participant enrollment, but it may also lead to a dilution of participant quality if not managed carefully. A focus on quantity over quality could compromise the integrity of the data collected.
options: Leverage social media campaigns targeting specific demographics to raise awareness and attract participants with NREM parasomnia.
Collaborate with local sleep disorder support groups to facilitate word-of-mouth referrals and build trust within the community.
Implement a community outreach program that includes informational sessions at local health fairs to educate potential participants about the study.
review: Increasing recruitment efforts may boost participant numbers, but the options do not address how to maintain rigorous screening standards amidst higher volume.

options: Integrate advanced sensor technologies that provide real-time physiological data alongside traditional monitoring methods to enhance data richness.

review: While enhancing data collection methods can improve insights, the options do not consider the potential increase in data processing challenges and participant burden.
